response.query: What pseudo-label confidence thresholds and teacher-student ramp schedule will we pre-specify? How will we tune thresholds using precision/recall trade-offs per-size bucket?
response.answer: Pseudo-label confidence thresholds will be set at 0.7, with a ramp schedule starting at 0.5 and increasing by 0.1 every 1000 labeled samples. Thresholds will be tuned based on precision/recall trade-offs per-size bucket.

results.title: Knowledge-Based AI
results.content: The course features a rigorous workload, including weekly assignments, open-ended mini-projects, proctored exams, and a semester-long project to build an AI agent for solving Raven’s Progressive Matrices (RPM). On top of trying to get back into school, especially an online school, and learning how to use Python to deliver the projects which one is due almost every week, we had to write 5 page papers weekly, do at least 3 peer reviews, watch 2-3 lessons that were sort of boring, midterm, final, and a very difficult final project which we gradually build during the whole class timeline that hold a pretty big chunk of the overall grade .I had a 90% and it dropped to 86% because the TA gave me a super low grade on the paper, although I had been receiving mostly A's on all my papers. For the mini-projects, there were a handful of people who worked ahead very quickly, figured out short cuts to solving them all, and then described the easiest solutions on Ed. Others will rightly point out that when it comes to learning you get out what you put in, but when you’re assigned 4-8 pages to write every single week, it’s hard to not take the easy path when it’s sitting right there in front of you.
